Class RecruitmentsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.RecruitmentsController
@RequestMapping("/api/admin/recruitments") @RestController public class RecruitmentsController extends ApiController
Admin management of recruitments. Every creation, deletion and change of status or dates is recorded in the recruitment audit trail (issue #139) through RecruitmentAuditService.
